jobs.description: <p> <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Chicago, Remote </p> <h2><strong>Who we are </strong></h2> <h3><strong>About Stripe</strong></h3> <p><span>Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.</span></p> <h3><strong>About the team</strong></h3> <p>The Recruiting team builds Stripe’s culture by connecting exceptional talent with our highest-impact business needs. We bring Stripe’s operating principles to life through thoughtful, consistent hiring practices, a high-quality candidate experience, and data-informed partnership with the business.</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <p>Stripe is looking for a consultative, creative recruiter to support critical Core Business functions. You will partner with senior leaders who shape Stripe’s financial strategy, external narrative, long-term growth, and company-wide decision-making.</p> <p>This is a high-impact portfolio with varied talent markets, senior stakeholders, and roles where the quality of each hire can influence how Stripe operates and grows. You will own full-cycle recruiting, advise leaders on hiring strategy and market conditions, and build trusted relationships with candidates and hiring teams.</p> <p><strong>This is a 12 month fixed term contract and you are employed directly through Stripe.</strong></p> <h3><strong>Responsibilities</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Partner with senior leaders to understand business priorities, define hiring plans, and develop recruiting strategies that support headcount goals.</li> <li>Own the full recruiting lifecycle, from intake and sourcing through offer acceptance and onboarding handoff.</li> <li>Advise hiring teams on talent-market conditions, candidate availability, competitive dynamics, and hiring approaches for specialized and senior roles.</li> <li>Develop and execute sourcing strategies that build broad, qualified candidate pipelines for current and future hiring needs.</li> <li>Build strong candidate relationships and deliver a thoughtful, timely candidate experience throughout the process.</li> <li>Use recruiting data to track progress, identify risks and opportunities, and provide clear updates to business leaders.</li> <li>Improve recruiting processes where needed, testing practical changes that help hiring teams move with clarity and consistency.</li> <li>Partner closely with cross-functional teams, including Finance, People Operations, Benefits, Onboarding, and Legal, to support a smooth offer and onboarding experience.</li> <li>Uphold structured, competency-based hiring practices and help hiring teams assess candidates against the requirements of each role.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Who you are</strong></h2> <p><span>We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role.
